If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation.      const wsAttachments: WsMessageAttachment[] = await Promise.all(\n        attachments.map(async (a) => ({\n          id: a.id,\n          originalFilename: a.originalFilename,\n          mimeType: record.channelId,\n          userId: data.userId,\n          leftAt: IsNull(),\n        },\n      });\n      if (!member) {\n        return null;\n      }\n\n      const messageRows: unknown = await [ANONYMOUS_USER_ID, deletedUserId, heldIds]\n                : [ANONYMOUS_USER_ID, deletedUserId];\n\n            await queryRunner.query(\n              `UPDATE messages\n             SET \"senderId\" = $1,\n                 content = '[message deleted by user]',\n                 embedding = NULL\n             WHERE ${whereClause}`,\n              params,\n            );\n          }\n\n          // Clean AI-derived PII using the message IDs collected before anonymization.\n          // BEFORE: message_entity_references and message_analysis rows were never cleaned.\n          // Also: there was a bug where IDs were collected AFTER anonymization by querying\n          // senderId=ANONYMOUS_USER_ID — which would return ALL anonymized users' messages.\n          // Using pre-collected userMessageIds is the correct approach.\n          if (userMessageIds.length > 0) {\n            await queryRunner.query(\n              `DELETE FROM message_entity_references WHERE \"messageId\" = ANY($1::uuid[])`,\n              [userMessageIds],\n            );\n            await queryRunner.query(\n              `DELETE FROM message_analysis WHERE \"messageId\" = ANY($1::uuid[])`,\n              [userMessageIds],\n            );\n          }\n\n          // Remove reactions\n          await queryRunner.query(`DELETE FROM message_reactions WHERE \"userId\" = $1`, [\n            deletedUserId,\n          ]);\n\n          // Remove receipts\n          await queryRunner.query(`DELETE FROM message_receipts WHERE \"userId\" = $1`, [\n            deletedUserId,\n          ]);\n\n          // Mark channel memberships as left\n          await queryRunner.query(\n            `UPDATE channel_members SET \"leftAt\" = NOW() WHERE \"userId\" = $1 AND \"leftAt\" IS NULL`,\n            [deletedUserId],\n          );\n\n          return objectKeys;\n        },\n      );\n\n      // MSG-CRITICAL-058: the attachment ROWS are committed-deleted; purge the MinIO\n      // binaries (best-effort, post-commit). Tenant-prefix isolation is enforced\n      // inside purgeObjects. A failed purge orphans the object for a reaper — it does\n      // not leave a live, resolvable PII reference.\n      if (objectKeysToPurge.length > 0) {\n        const purge = await this.attachmentObjectPurge.purgeObjects(\n          data.tenantId,\n          objectKeysToPurge,\n        );\n        if (purge.failed > 0) {\n          this.logger.error(\n            `UserDeleted erasure: ${purge.failed}/${purge.requested} attachment object(s) failed ` +\n              `to delete for tenant ${data.tenantId}; orphaned objects require reaper cleanup`,\n          );\n        }\n      }\n      this.logger.log(`UserDeleted cascade completed for deletedUserId ${deletedUserId}`);\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      this.logger.error(`UserDeleted cascade failed for ${deletedUserId}: ${errorMessage(err)}`);\n    }\n  }","numLines":480,"startLine":220,"totalLines":764}}}
